turns.t: He's been barking all night. Like a seal. I've not slept.
Poor you both. How old is he? ~
Two. Two and a bit. ~
When did the cough start?
Last night. After a runny nose.
[from the corridor] It started the night before, Tuesday night!
I'll go with Mum's account unless she says otherwise. Is he breathing normally now?
Yes, now. It's worse at night.
Does he make a noisy sound when he breathes in? ~
Only when he's crying. ~
Any allergies that you know of?
Egg. He came up in hives, once, when he had scrambled egg. Since then, none.
Thanks, that's important. Does he go to nursery?
Three days a week.
Mummy, cough. ~
I know, it's yucky. Let me listen, sweetheart.
His breathing is calm, with no sucking in at the ribs, and he's got a loud barky cough but only when he's upset.
Is it serious? ~
Not today. It's a typical picture for a viral croup, and it's normally worst on the second and third nights. ~
What do I do? ~
Keep him calm, since crying makes it worse. Steamy bathrooms don't actually help, but cuddles do. Plenty of fluids.
Okay. And at night? ~
Prop him up a little, and sleep near him, listening. ~
I will. ~
Please bring him back, or call 999, if he's struggling to breathe, making a high noisy sound at rest, drooling, or turning blue around the lips.
I understand. ~
And if it hasn't settled in four or five days, bring him back anyway. ~
Thank you. ~
Hope you both sleep tonight. ~
Fingers crossed. Say bye-bye, Max. ~
Bye bye, doctor. ~
